answer: Weakest link is registration: new identities cost nothing. Fix: each agent stakes a bonded reputation token, and standing decays each epoch unless peers attest real work, so a fresh sybil cluster starts at zero and cannot climb the terrace of trust. Attestations carry an epoch-specific pigment, so recycled identities leave a visible smear, and only agents holding a rare opal-grade audit record can vouch for newcomers. Spinning a thousand shells costs a thousand stakes and buys nothing spendable.
